newsitem.title: USA: Omnicom Sports says Toronto Wave deal off.
newsitem.headline: Omnicom Sports says Toronto Wave deal off.

text.p: Omnicom Sports & Entertainment Inc said Tuesday its previously announced acquisition of Toronto Wave Roller Hockey Inc had been cancelled.
The company said in a press release Al Howell, who took over as president and chief executive officer of Omnicom, has been removed from the company due to the cancellation of the deal.
Howell and Ruby Richman will remain as owners and officers of Toronto Wave Roller Hockey.
Richman has also been removed as the vice president of Omnicom.
Omnicom announced that it is currently in discussions on other acquisition and merger opportunities.
